title: Design System: Time Machine landing hero

extensions.scope: Current Persuade landing hero only; code-derived and not an approved comp. Existing dark application flow is outside this scope.

shadows.name: photo
shadows.purpose: Soft separation between overlapping ribbon photographs.

motion.name: button
motion.purpose: Background and transform transitions; hover translates upward 2px and active returns to rest.

motion.name: ribbon-cycle
motion.purpose: Shared timeline for nine outward mirrored pairs. Reduced motion is static; hidden documents suspend animation.

components.name: Camera CTA
components.description: The landing hero's single primary action opens camera capture.
components.html: <button class="ds-camera-cta">travel back in time<svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 7h10v10M7 17 17 7"/></svg></button>

narrative.overview: The hero uses warm paper, restrained dark type, generous open space, and mirrored photographs. Its distinguishing feature is matched past/present NYC imagery, with a single action leading to camera capture. Descriptive language here records the implementation; no separate creative north star has been approved.
dos: Do preserve matching landmarks, viewpoints, and phase across opposite sides.
Do keep the hero's one CTA connected to camera capture.
Do retain keyboard focus and the reduced-motion arrangement.
donts: Don't present generated reconstructions as archival photographs.
Don't apply this light hero palette to the existing app flow without a separate decision.
Don't treat this implementation record as an approved comp.
